summary_1line: Bhishma begins recounting how the custom of gifting umbrellas and sandals arose, through the story of Jamadagni, Renuka, and Surya.

image_candidates.scene_text: Renuka, exhausted under the blazing noon sun, sits briefly in the shade of a tree while clutching the arrows she must return to Jamadagni.
The furious sage Jamadagni stands with celestial bow drawn, aiming arrows toward the blazing sun in the sky.
Surya, disguised as a humble Brahmana, approaches the wrathful Jamadagni who is poised to shoot at the sun.
